graders.evidence:
I couldn't find any evidence of what people regret about moving to Tailwind v5. The searches turned up only the official announcement.

**What I verified**
- Tailwind CSS v5 was announced on 2026-08-20 ([tailwindcss.com/blog/tailwindcss-v5](https://tailwindcss.com/blog/tailwindcss-v5)).
- CSS-first config is now the default, and the JS config has been removed.
- There are new container query defaults.
- It is built on the Lightning CSS engine.
- The upgrade tool is `npx @tailwindcss/upgrade@5`.

**What I didn't find**
- No practitioner reports, GitHub issues, forum threads or blog posts about migration pain. Two Exa searches and two Tavily searches returned nothing beyond the announcement. One Tavily search limited to GitHub, Hacker News, Reddit and dev.to returned zero results.
- The vault had no pages on Tailwind.
- The social lane is missing. The `last30days` skill isn't installed, and that is the lane meant for practitioner opinion. Reddit, X and Hacker News threads are where regrets would show up, so this gap matters most for your question.

**Inference, not evidence:** the announced changes are the likeliest places for migration friction. Those are the removed JS config (affecting custom plugins, shared presets and config-driven tooling) and the changed container query defaults. I haven't seen anyone report problems with either, so treat that as a list of things to check.

**Next steps**
- Read the v5 upgrade guide and run the upgrade tool on a branch. Check how it handles your plugins and config.
- Search the `tailwindlabs/tailwindcss` issue tracker directly for "v5" or "upgrade".
- Install `last30days` and I'll rerun this with the social lane.

I didn't write anything to the vault, because the only source was the announcement and there were no findings to record.

**Coverage:** vault (empty on this topic), Exa (the announcement only), Tavily (the announcement only, then zero results on the domain-restricted search), social (`last30days` not installed), GitHub issues (not searched directly).

**What I found**
- Tailwind v5 was announced on 2026-08-20 in the [official post](https://tailwindcss.com/blog/tailwindcss-v5).
- It makes CSS-first configuration the default and removes the JavaScript config file.
- It adds new container query defaults and is built on the Lightning CSS engine.
- The migration tool is `npx @tailwindcss/upgrade@5`.

**What I didn't find**
- No migration post-mortems, forum threads, Reddit or Hacker News discussions, or GitHub issues about upgrading. Two web providers returned only the announcement. A search limited to GitHub, Reddit, HN, Stack Overflow and dev.to returned nothing dated after the release.

The removal of the JS config is the most likely source of pain, because it is a breaking change. Likely trouble spots would be JS-config-based plugins, theme values computed in JavaScript, and shared configs across a monorepo. Nobody has reported these in anything I found, so treat them as things to check, not known regrets.
